client_decisions.decision: The attached Orbit Coffee visual is approved artwork.
Client form states finished size 120×200 mm with 3 mm bleed.
Factory confirms 125×205 mm is the total artboard including 3 mm bleed on every edge; finished Trim is 119×199 mm.
Requested back net-content value changed from 200 g to 180 g.
Approved artwork currently shows 250 g on the front; v2 explicitly limits changes to the back legal copy and locks the front from movement or editing.
Factory requires all back text to be at least 6 pt.
Only inspect and correct the back legal copy; do not move the dieline, front, or barcode zone.
Based on v2, update only the corresponding text from 200 g to 180 g and rerun preflight; do not redo layout or color.

locked_items.item: dieline, front, barcode zone, and all unrelated artwork
locked_items.policy: Locked against movement or editing through v3. The source master remains byte-identical.
Exact text is 180 g; minimum nominal size remains 6.00 pt. Placement is not assumed without a target object or coordinates.
Preserved as the v3 pixel base; only localized text/specimen/version fields may change.

changed_items.change: Updated 200 g to 180 g in the standalone 6 pt specimen and corresponding v3 review fields.
Updated review-only version labels from v2 to v3 without reflow.
Created the v3 report, checklist, localized pixel-diff evidence, and verification record; layout and global colors were preserved.

unresolved_decisions.blocker: The flattened approved master has no editable back legal-copy object and no identifiable barcode-zone boundary.
unresolved_decisions.required_resolution: Provide the editable back production master or explicit legal-copy frame X/Y coordinates, dimensions, alignment, and barcode clearance.

unresolved_decisions.blocker: The front remains locked at 250 g while the requested back value is now 180 g.
unresolved_decisions.required_resolution: This remains a known cross-panel risk. A future instruction must resolve the values before production release; v3 does not alter the locked front.

unresolved_decisions.blocker: The supplied 1376×768 RGB flattened preview has insufficient pixels and incompatible per-panel geometry for the confirmed 119×199 mm Trim.
unresolved_decisions.required_resolution: Supply separated vector artwork or high-resolution per-side production masters sized to the confirmed 125×205 mm bleed page.

unresolved_decisions.blocker: No factory CMYK ICC profile or total ink limit is specified.
unresolved_decisions.required_resolution: Factory must supply the print condition, or client/factory must explicitly approve a named standard profile.

unresolved_decisions.blocker: The page and Trim dimensions are confirmed, but no formal structural dieline has been supplied.
unresolved_decisions.required_resolution: Supply the template showing structural zones, safety areas, and front/back orientation.
